body.statement: For either globally defined Moore--Penrose comparator \(b^{\mathrm{cmp}}\in\{b^{\mathrm{OVS}},b^{\mathrm{const}}\}\), \[\Delta_{\mathrm{cmp}}(P)=E_P[(b^{\mathrm{cmp}})^{\prime}\Gamma_P(X)b^{\mathrm{cmp}}-b^{\star}(X)^{\prime}\Gamma_P(X)b^{\star}(X)].\] Its pathwise derivative is the fully displayed observable formula in Definition \(\ref{def:gap-one-step}\): it includes \(\dot\Gamma_s\), the Moore--Penrose KKT derivative \(\dot b^{\mathrm{cmp}}_s\), and the envelope cancellation for \(\dot b^{\star}_s\). Under the stated sieve dimension, Gram-spectrum, and approximation conditions, the training-fold projected scores satisfy \(\|\widehat\zeta^{-\ell}_{\Delta,J_n}-\zeta_{\Delta,b^{\mathrm{cmp}}}\|_{P,2}=o_P(1)\). At every fixed law with locally constant comparator-KKT ranks, separated positive comparator-KKT singular values, and \(\Delta_{\mathrm{cmp}}(P)\ge\delta_0>0\), \[\sqrt n\{\widehat\Delta_{\mathrm{cmp}}-\Delta_{\mathrm{cmp}}(P)\}=n^{-1/2}\sum_{i=1}^n\zeta_{\Delta,b^{\mathrm{cmp}}}(O_i)+o_P(1),\qquad \widehat V_{\Delta,\mathrm{cmp}}\to_P E_P[\zeta_{\Delta,b^{\mathrm{cmp}}}(O)^2].\] If this variance is positive, \(T_{\Delta,\mathrm{cmp}}\Rightarrow N(0,1)\), and the interval \(\widehat\Delta_{\mathrm{cmp}}\pm z_{1-\alpha/2}\sqrt{\widehat V_{\Delta,\mathrm{cmp}}/n}\) has pointwise coverage \(1-\alpha\).
body.justification: The efficiency comparison becomes empirically interpretable only when sampling uncertainty in the optimized variance loss is quantified.
body.gap: Sant'Anna and Xu (2026) construct a Hausman comparison for regular DiD estimators; they do not derive inference for an optimized conditional-versus-constant DDD variance functional.
body.consumer: A \(\texttt{triplediff}\) user can report whether an estimated precision gain is separated from zero rather than comparing standard errors informally.
